title: AgentsPay
summary: Pay an attested AI provider per unit of work: escrow a deposit, then settle from a payer voucher and an enclave-signed usage receipt.
what: AgentsPay is an Anchor 1.2.2 program for metered agent payments. Providers prove their gateway build with a TEE attestation that verifiers approve. Payers open sessions with an escrowed deposit. Anyone can crank settle with two Ed25519-signed messages; the program pays the provider the lesser of what the payer authorised and what the enclave metered.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentspay/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/AgentsPay-Sol.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentspay/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran a full session.
try_steps.see: Session Gor1BbrL… is Closed with settled 500_000.

diagram: admin --initialize/approve_measurement--> config; operator --register_provider/submit_attestation--> provider+attestation; verifier --approve_attestation--> Active; payer --open_session--> escrow; cranker --[Ed25519 voucher, Ed25519 receipt, settle]--> provider payout + treasury fee; close_session --> payer refund.
accounts: session PDA (payer, provider, salt) with escrow ATA
innovation: Payment needs both sides' signatures: the payer caps spend with vouchers and the attested enclave attests usage, so neither can overcharge alone.
exercises: What does settle pay if the voucher is 600_000 but only 500 units at 1_000 were metered?
Why does settle read the instructions sysvar?
not_covered: Vaults, credit offerings, real TDX quotes
